acquisition_channels.details: Researched local search terms, used local keywords in YouTube tags, and said organic web traffic was growing.
Ran Meta video lead ads targeted by selected rural zip codes and landowner interests.
Published job footage and before-and-after videos on YouTube to support ads and reassure leads.
Received referrals from customers and the horse community.
Built word of mouth in the horse community, which shared the service.

ideas.delivery: The owner handles marketing, lead calls, and in-person quotes; an operating partner and operators run forestry skid steers on customers' land, with machines transported between jobs.
